address: 2F, Nijubashi Square, 3-2-3 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, 100-0005, Japan
bio: A specialist in dim sum, popular in cities around the world. The red exterior belies the classic dining experience within, which is lively on every visit. Enjoy the culture of dim sum with Chinese tea to your heart’s content. The full complement of authentic dishes includes jasmine-smoked pork, steamed scallop siu mai dumplings, steamed shrimp gyoza dumplings and rice-noodle rolls wrapped in fried tofu skin. If the weather’s nice, taking in the local ambience on the terrace is recommended....
